points.title: 童年与宗教启蒙
points.description: 赫尔曼·黑塞出生于德国巴登-符腾堡州的小镇卡尔夫，父母都是虔诚的新教传教士。童年时期，他接受了严格的宗教教育，同时接触了印度和中国哲学思想。这段经历形成了他日后作品中的精神探索主题。黑塞与父母关系紧张，特别是与父亲，这种家庭矛盾成为他后来作品中关于个体与权威冲突的重要素材。1890年，他进入毛尔布隆修道院学校，但仅七个月后便因健康问题和反抗权威而离开。
points.descriptionEn: Hermann Hesse was born in the small town of Calw, Germany, to devout Protestant missionary parents. His childhood was marked by strict religious education and exposure to Indian and Chinese philosophical ideas, which later became central themes in his works. Hesse had a strained relationship with his parents, particularly his father, a conflict that influenced his later writings about the tension between individuals and authority. In 1890, he entered the Maulbronn Seminary but left after seven months due to health issues and rebellion against authority.

points.place: 德国巴塞尔和斯图加特
points.title: 文学起步与早期创作
points.description: 黑塞在多个学校辗转学习，最终通过自学获得高中毕业资格。1895年，他在一家书店当学徒，这段经历让他接触到大量文学作品。1899年，他出版第一部诗集《浪漫之歌》，但反响平平。1904年，他的小说《彼得·卡门青德》获得巨大成功，使他一举成名。这部半自传体小说讲述了一个艺术家的成长故事，体现了黑塞对艺术与生活的思考。同年，他与玛丽亚·伯努利结婚，定居巴塞尔。这一时期，黑塞开始为《新苏黎世报》等刊物撰稿，逐渐确立了自己作为作家的地位。
points.descriptionEn: Hesse attended various schools before earning his high school diploma through self-study. In 1895, he worked as an apprentice in a bookstore, where he was exposed to a wide range of literature. In 1899, he published his first poetry collection 'Romantic Songs' with little success. In 1904, his novel 'Peter Camenzind' brought him widespread acclaim. This semi-autobiographical work tells the story of an artist's growth, reflecting Hesse's thoughts on art and life. The same year, he married Maria Bernoulli and settled in Basel. During this period, Hesse began contributing to publications like the 'Neue Zürcher Zeitung', establishing himself as a writer.

points.title: 创作高峰与婚姻危机
points.description: 1905年，黑塞移居瑞士伯尔尼，开始了创作生涯的黄金时期。1906年出版《在轮下》，探讨教育制度对年轻人的压迫。1910年出版《盖特露德》，展现艺术家的内心世界。1911年，他前往印度旅行，这次经历深刻影响了他的思想，促使他创作《悉达多》(1922)。1912年，他与妻子玛丽亚关系恶化，开始精神分析治疗，这段经历反映在1919年的《德米安》中。1913年，他获得瑞士公民身份，正式成为瑞士人。这一时期，黑塞的作品开始探索个体精神成长、自我实现等主题，奠定了他在德语文学中的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1905, Hesse moved to Bern, Switzerland, beginning the golden period of his literary career. In 1906, he published 'Beneath the Wheel', exploring the oppression of young people by the education system. In 1910, 'Gertrude' was released, depicting the inner world of an artist. In 1911, he traveled to India, a journey that profoundly influenced his thinking and led to 'Siddhartha' (1922). In 1912, his marriage to Maria deteriorated, and he began psychoanalysis, which reflected in 'Demian' (1919). In 1913, he obtained Swiss citizenship. During this period, Hesse's works began to explore themes of individual spiritual growth and self-realization, establishing his important position in German literature.

points.title: 战争反思与精神探索
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，黑塞发表了反战文章《朋友》，被德国民族主义者视为叛徒。1914-1916年间，他经历了严重的个人危机，包括父亲去世、婚姻破裂和精神崩溃。1919年，他与画家露特·魏格曼结婚，但这段婚姻也于1923年结束。1924年，他与妮侬·多尔夫结婚，这段婚姻持续到1933年。这一时期，黑塞创作了《德米安》(1919)、《克林索尔的最后夏天》(1920)、《荒原狼》(1927)等重要作品，深入探索现代人的精神困境。1923年，他正式获得瑞士国籍，彻底摆脱德国身份。1927年，他在蒙塔尼奥拉定居，开始创作《玻璃珠游戏》(1943)，这部作品成为他晚年思想的集大成者。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War I, Hesse published anti-war essays, causing German nationalists to label him a traitor. Between 1914-1916, he experienced a severe personal crisis, including his father's death, marital breakdown, and mental collapse. In 1919, he married painter Ruth Wenger, but the marriage ended in 1923. In 1924, he married Ninon Dolbin, a marriage that lasted until 1933. During this period, Hesse created major works like 'Demian' (1919), 'Klingsor's Last Summer' (1920), and 'Steppenwolf' (1927), deeply exploring the spiritual dilemmas of modern people. In 1923, he officially obtained Swiss citizenship, completely severing ties with Germany. In 1927, he settled in Montagnola, beginning work on 'The Glass Bead Game' (1943), which became the culmination of his later thought.

points.title: 晚年创作与诺贝尔奖
points.description: 1933年纳粹上台后，黑塞的作品被列为禁书，但他通过瑞士朋友继续在德国传播。1946年，他因'富有灵感的作品具有道义的高度和艺术的热忱'获得诺贝尔文学奖，这是对他一生文学成就的最高肯定。晚年，黑塞继续创作，1943年完成《玻璃珠游戏》，这部作品探讨了精神与文化的完美结合。他与托马斯·曼、罗曼·罗兰等作家保持密切联系，成为欧洲知识界的重要人物。1950年代，他的作品在美国和欧洲广受欢迎，影响了战后一代人的精神世界。1962年8月9日，黑塞在蒙塔尼奥拉逝世，享年85岁。他的作品被翻译成多种语言，对世界文学产生了深远影响，特别是在探索个体精神自由和自我实现方面。
points.descriptionEn: After the Nazi rise to power in 1933, Hesse's works were banned in Germany, but he continued to distribute them through Swiss friends. In 1946, he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature 'for his inspired writings which, while growing in boldness and penetration, exemplify the classical humanitarian ideals.' This was the highest recognition of his literary achievements. In his later years, Hesse continued writing, completing 'The Glass Bead Game' in 1943, which explores the perfect integration of spirit and culture. He maintained close contact with writers like Thomas Mann and Romain Rolland, becoming an important figure in European intellectual circles. In the 1950s, his works gained popularity in America and Europe, influencing the spiritual world of the post-war generation. On August 9, 1962, Hesse died in Montagnola at the age of 85. His works have been translated into many languages and have had a profound impact on world literature, particularly in exploring individual spiritual freedom and self-realization.

appraisal.zh: 黑塞通常被视为20世纪最重要的德语作家之一，其作品深入探索现代人的精神困境，在战争、异化与身份危机中为读者提供精神出路，对东方哲学的融汇也为西方文学带来新视角。不过也有研究者指出，他偏重知识分子与艺术家的内心世界，对社会政治现实有所回避，晚期作品趋于抽象，对东方思想的处理亦显简化。总体而言，他仍被看作重要的精神探索者与跨文化桥梁。
appraisal.en: Hesse is generally regarded as one of the most important German-language writers of the 20th century, whose work probes the spiritual predicaments of modern people and offers inner pathways amid war, alienation and identity crisis, while his engagement with Eastern philosophy brought new perspectives to Western literature. Yet some researchers note his focus on intellectuals and artists, a certain detachment from social and political reality, the growing abstraction of his later work, and a simplified handling of Eastern thought. On the whole he remains a major spiritual explorer and cultural bridge.

supporter.zh: 黑塞被赞誉为20世纪最重要的德语作家之一，他的作品深刻探索了人类精神世界的复杂性。支持者认为，黑塞通过文学为现代人提供了精神出路，特别是在面对战争、社会异化和身份危机时。他的作品如《荒原狼》和《德米安》帮助读者理解内心冲突，寻求自我实现。黑塞对东方哲学的融合，特别是印度思想，为西方文学带来了新的视角。他坚持个人自由和独立思考，反对盲从权威，这种精神影响了无数读者和作家。黑塞的作品超越了时代限制，成为永恒的精神指南。
supporter.en: Hermann Hesse is celebrated as one of the most important German writers of the 20th century, whose works deeply explore the complexity of the human spirit. Supporters believe that through his literature, Hesse provided spiritual pathways for modern people, especially in the face of war, social alienation, and identity crises. Works like 'Steppenwolf' and 'Demian' help readers understand inner conflicts and seek self-realization. Hesse's integration of Eastern philosophy, particularly Indian thought, brought new perspectives to Western literature. He upheld personal freedom and independent thinking, opposing blind obedience to authority, a spirit that has influenced countless readers and writers. Hesse's works transcend temporal limitations, becoming eternal spiritual guides.

critic.zh: 批评者指出黑塞的作品存在明显的局限性，特别是其精英主义倾向和对社会政治现实的回避。他的主角多为知识分子或艺术家，很少关注普通民众的生活困境。黑塞对个人精神世界的过度关注被批评为脱离社会现实，缺乏对社会变革的积极贡献。一些评论家认为他的后期作品，如《玻璃珠珠游戏》，过于抽象和理论化，失去了早期作品的活力。此外，黑塞对东方哲学的简化处理也被批评为肤浅，未能真正理解这些复杂思想体系。他的个人生活，包括多次婚姻失败，也被用来质疑其关于爱情和关系的观点。
critic.en: Critics point out significant limitations in Hesse's work, particularly his elitist tendencies and avoidance of social and political realities. His protagonists are mostly intellectuals or artists, rarely focusing on the struggles of ordinary people. Hesse's excessive focus on individual inner worlds is criticized as detached from social reality, lacking positive contributions to social change. Some commentators argue that his later works, like 'The Glass Bead Game', are overly abstract and theoretical, losing the vitality of his earlier works. Additionally, Hesse's simplified treatment of Eastern philosophy is criticized as superficial, failing to truly understand these complex philosophical systems. His personal life, including multiple failed marriages, has also been used to question his views on love and relationships.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，黑塞被定义为一位重要的精神探索者和文化桥梁。他的作品在两次世界大战期间及战后成为许多寻求精神慰藉的人的指南。黑塞的思想影响了存在主义、心理学和人文主义等多个领域。在流行文化中，他的名字已成为个人成长和精神自由的象征，特别是在1960-70年代的西方反文化运动中。学术界对黑塞的研究持续不断，学者们既肯定他对现代主义文学的贡献，也分析其作品中的矛盾和复杂性。黑塞的作品被翻译成多种语言，在全球范围内拥有广泛读者，使他成为真正意义上的世界作家。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Hesse is defined as an important spiritual explorer and cultural bridge. His works became guides for many seeking spiritual comfort during and after the World Wars. Hesse's ideas influenced existentialism, psychology, and humanism, among other fields. In popular culture, his name has become a symbol of personal growth and spiritual freedom, particularly during the 1960s-70s Western counterculture movement. Academic research on Hesse continues, with scholars both acknowledging his contributions to modernist literature and analyzing the contradictions and complexities in his works. Hesse's works have been translated into numerous languages and have a wide readership worldwide, making him a truly global writer.

self.zh: 每个人都是自己的医生，也是自己的病人。
self.en: Everyone is a physician to himself, and also his own patient.
